## AI

### Anthropic launches Claude Opus 5 AI model
🔥🔥🔥🔥◯ Anthropic released Claude Opus 5 on July 24, 2026, priced at $5 per million input tokens and $25 per million output tokens, matching Opus 4.8 pricing but achieving near-parity with the pricier flagship Claude Fable 5 (within 0.5% on CursorBench 3.2) at roughly half the cost per task. Opus 5 sets new state-of-the-art scores on Frontier-Bench v0.1 and GDPval-AA, more than doubling Opus 4.8's performance on Frontier-Bench, and triples the next-best model's score on ARC-AGI 3, though it still trails Anthropic's Mythos 5 on cybersecurity tasks. It becomes the new default model on Claude Max and the top model on Claude Pro, also gains a Fast mode running about 2.5x faster at twice the base price, and ships alongside beta features for mid-conversation tool changes and automatic fallbacks on the Claude Platform.
